# Raw context with a matching evaluator and component array

Authored nominal factory retains its raw property parameter and independently
binds one Object method formal through an invariant evaluator and exact array.
Its original body explicitly calls the raw property with null. The frozen
observer checks raw method metadata, callback order, array identity, covariance
failures, partial stores, captured and null results, and discarded calls.
The dependency profile supplies the authored provider as an external declaration.
